g.text: CIRCLES: seven steps, one letter each
say the framework out loud at the start so the interviewer follows
Clarify with the 3W's and H before you name a persona
Cut tools: Lin's A-C matrix, or revenue per point of effort
Summarize: name it, recap it, say why it beat the others
a 15-20 minute answer: spend the time on Cut, List, Evaluate
